summary: A continuous loop can reduce drift, but excessive synchronization produces noise, churn and misplaced confidence.

points.text: Regenerating on every file change wastes compute and destabilizes shared views. Trigger on declared semantic inputs, debounce bursts and retain a pinned version while review is pending.
Forcing every conversation into the repository creates low-signal records. Capture only decisions, constraints, corrected facts, unresolved questions and reusable learnings with a named owner.
A green freshness badge can certify only the alignment contract it measured. It cannot prove that the contract includes every relevant artifact or that a generated explanation is correct.
Automated write-back into code, specs or ADRs can launder an unreviewed human or model claim into apparent authority. Keep semantic write-back reviewable and attributable.
